node.title: THE MISSING LEMMA (found by cross-audit): rich-line exhaustiveness at near-k subcores
node.statement: Every (t+1)-rich line through a near-k subcore lies in {tangent pencil, quotient-with-tails, dihedral, affine-net} — no fifth class — and the post-strip residue is uniformly capped.
